info.title: Feedlr frontend API
info.description: Same-origin cookie JSON API. WebAuthn is native JSON; browser credential validation and one-use challenges remain server-owned. Mutations validate Origin/Sec-Fetch-Site and JSON bodies. OAuth callbacks alone redirect as document navigation. Native playback, chapters and image/media delivery retain their specialized contracts.

post.description: Start username-free discoverable authentication with {}. A username explicitly requests legacy named-key fallback. Each begin supersedes the pending session challenge; browser cancellation must begin again. Finish rotates and revokes the anonymous session.

default.description: JSON error

post.description: Validate challenge, expiry, RP, bound origin, user handle, owned credential, signature and verification. Discoverable login always requires verification; durable policy prevents named fallback downgrading newly enrolled keys. A well-formed finish consumes the challenge even when verification fails.

MediaStatePatch.description: Omitted properties preserve current state. completed and progressSeconds cannot be combined. completed=true requires a known duration. Completion uses one shared duration-dependent buffer; untouched items are never completed.

html.description: Sanitized HTML fetched from the existing allowlisted legal document.

username.description: Explicit compatibility fallback for existing non-discoverable keys. Omit for normal username-free passkey login.

LoginBegin.description: Send {} for discoverable login with user verification required. A supplied username invokes legacy named-key compatibility; newly enrolled keys still require verification.
